Definition: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
BiblicalUsage: There is the smallest word with the biggest job, for it puts God's people somewhere on purpose. There He put the man in the garden He had planted, there He confounded the language of all the earth, and there a widow woman was commanded to sustain Elijah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God puts His people somewhere on purpose, and there is never an accident in His geography.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
